items.problem: Project reconciliation did not clearly require preserving or raising TargetPlatformMinVersion for retained APIs.
items.evidence: session-log.txt turn 26 shows repeated CA1416 warnings because the scaffold minimum was 10.0.17763 while protection APIs require 10.0.18362; turn 27 raised the minimum and turn 28 built with zero warnings.
items.covered_at: MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md#csproj, Project File Updates and PackageReference reconciliation cheat-sheet
items.proposed_improvement: State that TargetPlatformMinVersion is reconciled separately from the TFM, begins at the higher source/scaffold minimum, and must be raised rather than suppressing CA1416.
items.generalizes: Many retained Windows Runtime APIs have minimum OS contracts newer than a blank WinUI scaffold's declared minimum.
